summary: Iteration 60 — Full testing of global booking flags system (enable_manual_approval_for_services, enable_pay_later_for_services). 24/24 backend tests pass. All 8 frontend scenarios verified and passing. One bug fixed (missing useEffect import in admin panel).
critical_code_review_comments: FIXED: admin/index.tsx was missing `useEffect` import (only useState, useCallback were imported). BookingConfigTab uses useEffect at line 502. This would cause 'useEffect is not defined' runtime error when Réservations tab is rendered. Fixed by adding useEffect to imports.
seed_data_creation: Test services created during flag normalization tests (TEST_SVC_*) were cleaned up. Some test bookings were created and immediately cancelled.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All global booking flags features fully verified and passing. Flags are at MVP defaults (both false). Bug fixed: useEffect was missing from admin/index.tsx imports. Backend: 24/24 tests in test_global_booking_flags_iter60.py. Frontend: Admin panel Réservations tab with correct testIDs (config-row-enable_manual_approval_for_services, toggle-enable_manual_approval_for_services etc), service badges (Réservation directe, Paiement immédiat), booking confirm without pay_later selector.
